# GitHub Copilot Instructions — Repositorio ADSO SENA CADPH Garzón

This repository is the official academic and software development portal for **SENA CADPH Garzón (Huila, Colombia)**, program **Tecnólogo en Análisis y Desarrollo de Software (ADSO)**.

## Key Rules
- Read and adhere to the guidelines in `.ai/CONTEXTO_ADSO.md` and `.ai/REGLAS_CODIGO.md`.
- When generating web components, use Semantic HTML5 and Tailwind CSS v3 utility classes with SENA institutional colors (SENA Green `#39A900`, dark blue `#0c384a`, background `#f0f3f6`).
- Write clean, modular ECMAScript 6+ JavaScript.
- Write commit messages following Conventional Commits in Spanish (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `style:`, `refactor:`, `test:`).
- For learning guides, materials, and evaluation rubrics, refer to `material-formativo/` and `docs/DisenoCurricularADSO.pdf`.
